title: Parse Git porcelain without trimming its status columns
trigger_preconditions: A helper feeds porcelain-v1 output through a generic stdout function that strips leading whitespace.
failure_signature: The first modified path lost its initial character because global stdout trimming removed the porcelain row's leading status space.
candidate_workaround: Read NUL-delimited porcelain bytes directly and remove exactly the three-byte status prefix from each complete record.
recurrence_guard: Never pass column-sensitive or NUL-delimited Git output through a text helper that applies strip.
rollback: Stop before x2 execution, give the failed preflight zero evidence credit, and preserve every existing path unchanged.
scope_boundary: Owner-local Git status parsing only; no evidence execution, full-suite, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
